summary: Ran full backend pytest (21 tests, 100% pass) covering auth, RBAC, container issue, kiosk RFID+weight verify (success & failure), duplicate return prevention, cleaning workflow (Washing->Ready->Available), analytics, settings RBAC, and student self endpoints. Ran Playwright UI tests: student login + dashboard render (wallet ₹, reuse cycles, green impact) OK; admin login + full sidebar navigation OK after fix; end-to-end kiosk return flow at /kiosk (Start -> select -> RFID detect -> weight verify empty -> ₹30 refund shown) OK. Fixed one React runtime bug ('destroy is not a function') caused by arrow-shorthand load() returning a Promise being passed to useEffect in admin ReturnContainer and Containers pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/ReturnContainer.jsx and Containers.jsx used `const load = () => api.get(...).then(...)` and passed `load` directly to useEffect. Because the arrow implicitly returned a Promise, React treated it as the cleanup function and threw 'destroy is not a function' on unmount. Wrapped body in braces so load() returns undefined. Recommend main agent audit any other `useEffect(fn, [])` where fn is an arrow-shorthand returning a Promise (Cleaning.jsx and IssueContainer.jsx are already safe because their load functions have block bodies).
server.py is 700+ lines in a single file. Splitting into routers (auth, containers, kiosk, cleaning, analytics, settings) would improve maintainability.

Auth cookies set with samesite='none' + secure=True but frontend primarily relies on Bearer token in localStorage. This is fine but the dual mechanism should be documented; XSS on the SPA would leak the token.
No brute-force lockout on /auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout). Not implemented; consider adding rate-limit/lockout.

seed() early-returns if any students already exist; therefore if admin/staff password env changes, existing admin's password_hash is NOT updated (idempotent seed but not idempotent update). Minor for demo, but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; used backend's built-in seed. Test-created data uses TEST_ prefix in register test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend contract is stable and all endpoints in scope pass. Auth is Bearer-token via localStorage key 'reloop_token'. Login redirects to /app (not /admin or /student); role determines rendered dashboard component. Kiosk simulator at /kiosk is fully functional. If regressions appear, first re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v
